@@ -5,7 +5,9 @@ git_source(:github) { |repo_name| "https://github.com/#{repo_name}" }
 gem "lolcat", "~> 100.0"
 gem "optimist", "~> 3.0"
 gem "pastel", "~> 0.8.0"
-gem "rouge", "~> 3.26"
+# refer ~/bin/setup-user
+#gem 'rouge', :github => 'wstein/rouge', :branch => 'feature/dracula-colorful'
 gem "rubocop", "~> 1.10"
 gem "ruby_figlet", "~> 0.6.1"
+gem "specific_install", "~> 0.3.5"
 gem "tty-cursor", "~> 0.7.1"

@@ -49,9 +49,14 @@ install_zsh_antigen() {
 }
 
 setup_gems() {
-	BUNDLER_CMD=$(command -v bundler)
-	if [ -n "${BUNDLER_CMD}" ]; then
-		PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin GEM_HOME=$HOME/.gem ${BUNDLER_CMD} install --gemfile ~/bin/Gemfile
+	GEM_CMD=$(command -v gem)
+	if [ -n "${GEM_CMD}" ]; then
+		PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin GEM_HOME=$HOME/.gem ${GEM_CMD} install --file ~/bin/Gemfile
+
+		# work-a-round to install my version of rouge with dracula theme
+		echo ${GEM_CMD} specific_install --user "https://github.com/wstein/rouge" "feature/dracula-colorful"
+		PAGER="cat" PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin" GEM_HOME="$HOME/.gem" ${GEM_CMD} specific_install --user "https://github.com/wstein/rouge" "feature/dracula-colorful"
+		mv ~/.gem/ruby/bin/rougify ~/.local/bin || mv ~/.gem/ruby/*/bin/rougify ~/.local/bin
 	fi
 }
